end

addField("Nickname")

addField("Following")
addField("Hearts")
addField("Videos")
addField("Bio")

local function updateAvatar(url)
    avatar.Image = ""
    if not url or url == "" then return end
    pcall(function()
        local content = game:HttpGet(url)
        local file = "fox_" .. tick() .. ".png"
        writefile(file, content)
        avatar.Image = getcustomasset(file)
    end)
end

btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local user = input.Text:gsub("@", "")
    if user == "" then return end

    btn.Text = "SEARCHING..."
    btn.Active = false
    avatar.Image = ""
    
    local success, response = pcall(function()
        return game:HttpGet("https://xxxxxthefox-tiktok-information.onrender.com/scan/" .. user)
    end)

    if success then
        local data = HttpService:JSONDecode(response)
        if data.status == "success" then
            local info = data.account_info
            local stats = data.statistics
            
            task.spawn(function() updateAvatar(info.avatar) end)

            fields["Nickname"].Text = " 👤 Nick: " .. (info.nickname or "N/A")
            fields["Followers"].Text = " 👥 Followers: " .. (stats.followers or 0)
            fields["Following"].Text = " 🏹 Following: " .. (stats.following or 0)
            fields["Hearts"].Text = " ❤️ Hearts: " .. (stats.hearts or 0)
            fields["Videos"].Text = " 🎬 Videos: " .. (stats.videos or 0)
            fields["Bio"].Text = " 📝 Bio: " .. (info.signature or "None")
            
            btn.Text = "SUCCESS"
        else
            btn.Text = "NOT FOUND"
        end
    else
        btn.Text = "ERROR"
    end

    task.wait(1)
    btn.Text = "FETCH DATA"
    btn.Active = true
end)

    b.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, posY, 0)
    b.Text = text; b.BackgroundColor3 = color; b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    b.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold; b.TextSize = 14
    Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6); return b
end

-- الأزرار المنفصلة
local B_Hitbox = AddButton("Hitbox (ضرب بعيد): OFF", 0.11, Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 45))
local B_KillA  = AddButton("Kill Aura (تلقائي): OFF", 0.19, Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 45))
local B_AimP   = AddButton("أيم لاعبين: OFF", 0.27, Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 45))
local B_AimR   = AddButton("أيم روبوتات: OFF", 0.35, Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 45))
local B_ESP    = AddButton("رؤية شاملة وتوهج: OFF", 0.43, Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 45))
local B_Jump   = AddButton("قفز طيران: OFF", 0.51, Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 45))
local B_Hop    = AddButton("🔍 سيرفر فارغ", 0.60, Color3.fromRGB(180, 40, 40))

local Config = {Hitbox = false, KillAura = false, AimP = false, AimR = false, ESP = false, Jump = false}

-- برمجة تفعيل الأزرار
local function Toggle(cfg, btn, name)
    Config[cfg] = not Config[cfg]
    btn.Text = name..": "..(Config[cfg] and "ON ✅" or "OFF ❌")
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Config[cfg] and Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 60) or Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 45)
end

B_Hitbox.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() Toggle("Hitbox", B_Hitbox, "Hitbox") end)
B_KillA.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() Toggle("KillAura", B_KillA, "Kill Aura") end)
B_AimP.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() Toggle("AimP", B_AimP, "أيم لاعبين") end)
B_AimR.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() Toggle("AimR", B_AimR, "أيم روبوتات") end)
B_ESP.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() Toggle("ESP", B_ESP, "رؤية وتوهج") end)
B_Jump.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() Toggle("Jump", B_Jump, "قفز طيران") end)

-- [القفز اللانهائي]
UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    if Config.Jump and LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
        LP.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"):ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
    end
end)

-- ==========================================
-- 2. المحرك العالمي (روبوتات + لاعبين)
-- ==========================================
local Targets = {}
local function CheckTarget(char)
    if not char or char == LP.Character then return nil end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return nil end
    
    local plr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char)
    if plr then
        if (plr.Team == LP.Team and LP.Team ~= nil) or LP:IsFriendsWith(plr.UserId) then return "Friend" end
        return "Player"
    end
    -- إذا لم يكن لاعباً وصحته > 0 فهو روبوت/عدو في اللعبة
    return "Robot"
end

task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(1) do
        local temp = {}
        for _, v in pairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("Humanoid") and v.Parent then
                local t = CheckTarget(v.Parent)
                if t then temp[v.Parent] = t end
            end
        end
        Targets = temp
    end
end)

-- ==========================================
-- 3. التنفيذ الميداني (الحركة والضرب)
-- ==========================================
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local myChar = LP.Character
    if not myChar or not myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    
    local closest = nil
    local shortestDist = 600

    for char, tType in pairs(Targets) do
        local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        if root and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and char.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
            local dist = (myChar.HumanoidRootPart.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
            
            -- [Hitbox] تكبير العدو (ليس صديقاً)
            if Config.Hitbox and tType ~= "Friend" and dist < 500 then
                root.Size = Vector3.new(25, 25, 25); root.Transparency = 0.8; root.CanCollide = false
            elseif root.Size.X > 2 then
                root.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 1); root.CanCollide = true
            end

            -- [Kill Aura] القتل التلقائي
            if Config.KillAura and tType ~= "Friend" and dist < 25 then
                local tool = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
                if tool then tool:Activate() end
            end

            -- [ESP] الرؤية والتوهج
            if Config.ESP then
                local clr = (tType == "Friend" and Color3.new(0,1,0) or Color3.new(1,0,0))
                if not char:FindFirstChild("V220_H") then
                    local h = Instance.new("Highlight", char); h.Name = "V220_H"
                    h.FillTransparency = 0.5; h.OutlineTransparency = 0
                end
                char.V220_H.FillColor = clr; char.V220_H.OutlineColor = clr
            else
                if char:FindFirstChild("V220_H") then char.V220_H:Destroy() end
            end

            -- [تحديد الأقرب للأيم بوت]
            local canAim = (tType == "Player" and Config.AimP) or (tType == "Robot" and Config.AimR)
            if canAim and dist < shortestDist then
                local _, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
                if onScreen then shortestDist = dist; closest = root end
            end
        end
    end

    -- تنفيذ الأيم بوت الناعم
    if closest then
        local lookAt = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, closest.Position)
        Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(lookAt, 0.15)
    end
end)
